lead: Liam Neeson is an Irish film actor, born on 7 June 1952 in Ballymena.
As of 2026, he is 74 years old, and his birth date places him under the Gemini sign.
He has represented Bohemian F.C. and is associated with work such as Schindler's List, Star Wars: Episode I – The Phantom Menace and Taken.

sections.heading: Liam Neeson — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Liam Neeson was born on 7 June 1952 in Ballymena, and holds Irish, American and British nationality. He was given the name William John Neeson at birth and is publicly known as Liam Neeson.
Public records name his father, Bernard Neeson and his mother, Catherine Brown.
His listed education includes Queen's University Belfast and St Patrick's College.
He is recorded as speaking English.

sections.heading: Liam Neeson — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists film actor, voice actor, stage actor, television actor and musician as his occupations.
On the team sheet, Liam has been associated with Bohemian F.C.
Among the credits most often linked to Liam are Schindler's List, Star Wars: Episode I – The Phantom Menace, Taken and Darkman.
